title: A drain does not stop on its own failed attempt worktrees at the lane budget
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/pilot-py/lanes/preflight-proof-py.log: after 5 failed attempts (exit 73, "rerun reuses it, claim released") the drain stopped with exit 64: "6 live lane worktrees (maximum 6, KRN_LANE_MAX_LIVE) ... t-0zf6ehp (no ship record)". Failed attempts keep their worktree for a rerun, so a drain of N > 6 tasks fails on its own leftovers.
Outcome: krn lane run --ready does not count worktrees of its own failed attempts (claim released, no live process) against the live-lane budget, or prunes them before the next start; a drain of 10 attempts never stops on its own leftovers.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/drain.ts, src/cli/lane.ts
Proof: a drain test with 7 failing tasks runs all 7 and never exits 64 for the lane budget.
